tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// me khyi'i mi zad gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rta pa'i zla tshes sgra gcan dus mes ri bong 'dzin par 'jug pa'i ri mo shar tshe sgo yig dge ba'i 'phrin shod ces bya ba bzhugs// bde stong ya bral min pa'i ye shes kyi// snang ba bla na med pa'i 'khor lo yis// srid pa mya ngan las 'das chos ji snyed// dbang sgyur bla ma dang po'i sangs rgyas 'dud// gang dag skyabs su nges par bsten tsam gyis// lam log 'jigs pa las skyob sdom pa'i tshogs// legs bskyed yang dag lam nas 'dren mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum po gtsug tu mchod byas nas// pra 'phrul mig gi mthong snang ma bsgrubs shing*// dus gsum gzigs pa'i go sar son min yang*// dpyad gsum rnam dag gtsug lag sbyangs stobs kyis// zla ba sgra gcan phrad tshul cung zad gleng*// de la spyir bstan bzhed pa'i tshul mang yang*// yongs grags rig byed gtam gyi rjes 'brang tshe// skabs gsum dbang po rnams kyis sa 'dzin dbang*// nor rgyas kyis 'khyud srub shing srub thag bcas// rin chen 'byung gnas bsrubs bcud zla ba dug /bdud rtsi'i bcud sogs ci 'dod 'byon pa na// bdud rtsi lha min khyer la ma bzod par// khyab 'jug bcud bral bu mo'i zol gyis phrogs// lha yul 'chi med gsos su 'gyed pa na// sgra gcan g.yo sgyus bgo skal nod pa de// lha bu zla bas smras nas khyab 'jug gis// 'khor los bsnun pas sgra gcan mgrin pa dral// de yi 'khon lan blan phyir mgo zlum gyis// nyi zla bza' bar gyur ces dmod bor bas// srid pa'i mig dag sgrib pa yin zhes gleng*// gsang chen rgyud kyi rgyal pos phyi ltar na// sgra gcan lus kyis nam mkha'i go la phyed// khyab par bsod nams ldan pas g.yas skor du// rgyu ba gang tshe lus gzhan stong pa yis// dngos po gzhan dag sgrib par mi srid mod// gdong mjug bai ḍūr+ya yi rang bzhin gyis// nyi zla la sogs g.yon skor bgrod pa dang*// phrad pas shel mdangs sgrib la 'dzin par grags// nang ltar rdo rje'i lus kyi kun 'dar ma'i// yar rtse spyi bo'i haṃ dkar sgra gcan gdong*// mar sna lte ba'i a thung dus me dang*// ro rkyang nyi zla'i rtsa khams dkar dmar zung*// kha sbyor gang tshe phyi rol nyi ma 'dzin// rkyang ma'i khams sbyar kho nas zla ba nongs// gzhan du rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi

/rang bzhin bde stong ye shes mngon bgyi phyir// rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul mkhas pas der// gnad du bsnun pas ro rkyang nyi zla yi// rlung sems a wa dhū tīr zhugs pa'i tshe// mtshon bya bde chen lhan skyes ye shes nyid// mngon gyur gang tshe phyi rol snang byed kyi// sgron ma spun dag seng ge mo bus 'jug /bye brag snang srid chos kun grangs yig gi /gzugs brnyan ston pa gaṇ+ḍa'i chu gter klong*// rtsis rig sbyangs pa'i ngang dkar glu len mas// bsgyur bgod 'phur lding rtse 'jor spyod pa na// 'byung 'gyur 'phrin du shod la blo mig ldan// mi dgyes med pa'i ltas mo bkrag cher snang*// de yang rab byung nas brtsams bgrang ba'i gzhi// 'dod pa'i grangs mnyam tshogs pa'i ya gyal du// bi shwa na ra'i bu yi lus drod kyi// reg byar dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i dbyig gi bshes// zhes grags gnam lo gsar tshes zhag gi mdzod// gso rig hor rtsis mthun pa'i dang po'i zla// sgrol byed legs bris bu mo mchu snyung mas// ri dwags rtags can dar bab lang tsho yi// 'jo sgeg zil dngar ngoms med btung ba'i dus// rnam dag grub par nyin mo'i mgon po nyid// chu srin khyim slebs zhag bzhi 'das pa'i mtshams// srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dus kyi mes// chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor sgrib pa'i tshul// dus me zla ba phan tshun sbyangs res la// khyad par ma byung hril por bsgrib tshul dang*// bsdus rgyud rjes 'brang mjug gi kun phan la// sbyangs pas zla ba'i cha bdun 'dzad pa'am// lnga char gcig gi sum chas dman yang srid// dus tshad grub lugs bco lnga'i tshes longs las// mkha' dbang srang

13 'dod dbugs mda' 5 nyin mo brgal// de lhag mun sros chu tshod bu 7 ga 4 srang*// dus 407 mtsho dbugs thig bco lnga'i tshes rdzogs nas// bcu drug longs spyod dbyug gur ma 4 tsho srang la// drag 10 po dbu 1 gas mig 2 longs su spyad mtshams sam// nges pa'i lugs gcig chu tshod 'dod 13 pa ni/ 13 57 2 60 /rjes 'brang bcas pa'i byi ba'i dus tshod mthar// dus mes zla bar 'jug pa'i lugs kyang yod// byed rtsis lugs kyi ri mor mtshan mo yi// longs spyod chu tshod brgyad dang srang zhe bdun// brgal ba'i dus der 'dzin pa yongs grags smra// 'dzin phyogs nam stod byang ngam byang smad la// nye ba'i phyogs nas bzung mthar lhag med dam// lhag lus gang tshe cha bdun byed grub khyad// sgrib yun grub par chu tshod bcu gnyis dang*// cig shos ltar na chu tshod drug yun gnas// lhag lus lho'am lho nub phyogs su lhag /bzung ba'i kha dog thog mthar dud kha dang*// zangs kyi kha dog gang rung 'byung bar bshad// gso ba hril por bsgribs la bzung phyogs dang*// cha 'dzin lus pa'i phyogs nas 'tshob 'gyur zhes// lkog gyur mkhyen pa rnams kyi lug srol zung*// ma 'dres so sor bkod pa de tsam lags// bzang ngan 'bras bu mchu zlar gza' 'dzin gyi// 'bras bu bram ze rta dang glang po bde// chos sgrub pa la gus par byed pa dang*// zhing par mi dge char pa 'bab ces byung*// gang tshe sgo gsum sgrib sbyong dge tshogs bskrun// yi ge 'dri mchod la sogs chos spyod bcu// sbyin sogs bsdu dngos pha rol phyin spyad sogs// dge tshogs gang bsags bye ba bdun 'gyur du// rgyal bas mdo rgyud rnams las lan gcig min// gsungs don legs 'dod rnams kyis nyams su longs// khyad par nges don dus kyi 'khor lo las// zla 'dzin rkyang ma'i rlung sems dbu ma ru// chud pa gang tshe zab lam bzlas bsgom dang*// rim gnyis bsgoms pas gya nom yon tan la// dbang 'byor phyir na nyams bzhes mi bskyud 'tshal// 'di bris dge ba'i pho nyas dkon mchog gi

/thugs rje byin rlabs dar bab mdza' na mo// lus can bsod nams khab tu yongs bkug nas// bde ba rgyur bcas dga' ston spyod gyur cig /bdag cag byang chub bar gyi skye nas skyer// tshul khrims kyis gtsang thos bsam bsgom par brtson// phyi nang gtsug lag rin chen 'od snang gis// skye 'gro'i mi shes mun sel nyid gyur cig /ces me khyi'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rta pa'i zla tshes sgra gcan dus mes ri bong 'dzin par 'jug pa'i ri mo shar tshe/ sgo yig dge ba'i 'phrin shod ces pa 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi 'dren pa mchog gi bar du legs par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa yi dam rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med kyi zhing nas byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba khrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang*/ lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa'i bstan pa rin po che skyong zhing rgya cher rgyas par byed par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan srung yongs kyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi/ bka' 'bangs dregs pa sde brgyad/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring*/

sprul pa ru 'dren sde bzhi/ rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi'i dmag tshogs/ nor bdag dur khrod yab yum/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ bdud phrug bye ba 'bum sde/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dmag tshogs/ dpal mgon trag shad gnyan po/ mgon po stag zhon lcam dral/ gnyan mgon chen po'i bka' sdod gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ las mkhan srog zan dmar po/ 'khor srog gcod kyi shan pa la sogs snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhir bcas pa'i gtsang ma ris kyi dpal mgon mthu bo che rnams dang*/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i dkar phyogs skyong ba la mngon par dga' ba sde dang ris su gtogs pa dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ deng sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa'i snang byed chen po mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa dang*/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa lta bu'i mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bstan pa rin po che dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gang dag bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs shing rjes su slob pa'i slob 'bangs ji snyed tshogs dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par bstan pa la lhag bsam dkar ba'i tshul khrims rin chen zhes bya ba la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsam pa ngan pa dang*/

sbyor ba rtsub mo'i las rtsom par byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kyi mthu dang nus pa stobs dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad bcom zhing phyir bzlog pa dang*/ slad du'ang las ngan gyi rgyun gcod pa'i phyir/ lus ngag thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag nas/ rnam par shes pa chos dbyings zab mo skye ba med pa'i ngang du 'phos pa'i phyir/ zab mo snang ba'i mdo tshar gsum 'don pa la thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu thugs gtod par gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi na ci gnang*/ zhes brjod la mdo 'don par bya'o// ༈ //dam pa rnams ni dud 'gror skyes gyur kyang*// rang gzhan legs lam 'god pa smon lam shugs// gaṅgā lam gsum rgyu yang nyes skyon dri// zhi bsil bde rgyur sbyor ba'i zil mngar byed// kā sha'i yul bdag rgyal pos bsrungs pa'i phyogs// nags tshal stug po zhig tu glang chen sprel// ri bong gong ma srad de srog chags bzhi// byung ba phan tshun yid gcugs mdza' bar gnas// de dag gcig nas gcig tu bla mar bkur// ri mor byed ched rgan rim bgrang ba'i gzhi// n+yā gro dha yi ljon par tshad gzhal tshe// glang pos rang nyid khyur bcas rgyu ba na// shing 'di bdag lus dpangs tshad skyes pa mthong*// sprel gyis kho bo rgyu 'grul thub tsa na// shing 'di rang lus dang mnyam skyes pa dran// ri bong gis ni shing gi lo 'dab gnyis// zil pa chags pas ro 'dzin bldag pa shes// gong sred bdag gis 'bras bu gzhan zos pa'i// bshang ba dor ba'i sa bon las ni shing*// 'di nyid skyes smras snga ma snga ma las// phyi ma rgan rim bsnyen bkur rje sa dang*// lam du bgrod tshe gzhon pas rgan khur ba// g.yar dam bcas pa kun gyis nyams su bstar// smra mkhas gong ma sred kyis slar smras pa// mchod 'os mchod pa'i bslab par legs gnas kyang*// da dung rang re bslab pa'i gnas lnga la// slob pa thar pa thams cad mkhyen rgyu zhes// gsungs pa de la goms pa skal ba bzang*// de tshul bka' stsal gnang dang bslab par bgyi// zhus par rtsa ba me tog 'bras bu la// srog chags med par spyad kyi yod pa min// ci phyir srog chags bsad pa'i nyes pa che// 'bru sogs gzhan gyis bdag bzung ma byas par// spyad kyi gzhan dbang gyur pa brkus gyur na// ma byin blangs pa'i nyes pa 'byung bas spangs// bsgrod bya'i yul la 'jug pa mi 'gog kyang*// bsgrod bya min la 'khrig pa log g.yem ste// nyes skyon brgyud ma'i 'byung gnas spang bar byos// brtags don tshul bzhin smra la mkhas bya mod// dam pa min la dam par khas 'che ba// de sogs gya gyu bden min smra ba ni// brdzun gtam nyid de srog gi phyir yang spongs// myos byed min pa'i 'bru rigs longs spyad kyi// myos 'gyur 'bru dang bcos pa'i chang gi rigs// bag med gnas las byol ba'i brtul zhugs bzung*// de skad stsal ba'i bslab khrims blang bar bcas// slar yang gong ma sred kyis 'di skad du// rang re brtul zhugs der gnas shin tu legs// 'on kyang srog chags gzhan yang der dgod bya// zhes gsungs grogs po gsum gas rang rang gi

/rigs mthun bslab bya 'bogs pa dam bcas nas// srog chags grangs med bslab pa'i khrims lngar bkod// de tshe yul de'i bde skyid dpal 'byor rgyas// lo legs mi phyugs phun sum tshogs gyur pa// tshul de rgyal blon btsun mo 'khor 'bangs dag /tha dad bsod nams thur snyam ma shes par// gang tshe drang srong mngon shes lnga ldan drung*// dris pas gzhan pa su yis mthu ma lags// nags khrod gnas pa'i srog chags dam pa bzhi'i// rang gzhan mang po bslab gzhi bkod pa'i mthu// zhes stsal de la ngo mtshar cher skyes pa'i// mi bdag 'khor 'bangs bgrang du med pas kyang*// brtul zhugs lnga la sbyar bas shi 'phos rigs// sum cu rtsa gsum lhar skyes legs bris pa// grangs med 'phel ba brgya byin gyis brtags pas// 'dzam gling sems can mang po srog chags bzhis// mngon mtho'i lam du sbyar ba'i mthur zhes so// gang tshe gong ma sred ni shākya thub// ri bong sha ri'i bu dang spre'u ni// mauṅgal bu yin glang chen kun dga' bo// nges par ston pa'i mchog gi 'dul lung bzhir// 'byung don rtogs brjod ri mo'i lam song ba// dad spro dar la bab pa'i rkang rtse yis// blo gros mya ngan med par kha bye ba// a nan+da dharmai dhas bskul ba'i ngor// tshul khrims rin chen bod pas bslab pa'i gnas// rgan rim mchod dang rtsa bzhi myos 'gyur bcas// spang blang 'dzol med bgyis pa'i bsod nams stobs// dpag yas thob pa rgyal gsung dri med kyis// brjod bya don gnyer dga' ba bskyed phyir bris// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
